design_check.binning_rule: controlled_anchor; cp needs >=5 quadruples; main statistic over cp medians

debiased_empirical_sensitivity.construction: bootstrap SE divided by the iid-calibration inflation factor of the same cp structure

iid_analytic_sensitivity.construction: 1/sqrt(n_cp-1) (ignores cell clustering; NOT used for the gate)

primary_empirical_cluster_adjusted.construction: n_eff from cell-cluster bootstrap SE of the within-screen barcode split-half reliability (Validation, full cp coverage); SE_null=1/sqrt(n_eff-1); MDE80=2.801585*SE_null

mde80_obs.zero_model_cell_share_sensitivities_note: STRUCTURAL CAVEAT: additive cell main effects cancel exactly in the Q double difference, so a cell-additive component u_c is not a structurally faithful null for Q; these cell-share models are reported only as a PESSIMISTIC dependence bound for the design SE. The primary anchored quantities are the empirical cluster-adjusted MDE80_obs and its iid-debiased version.

reliability.coverage_note: barcode split-half is a same-screen reproducibility proxy; Original split coverage is thin (61 cp from 36 barcode-rich cells, CI on rel is wide) while Validation covers all 1501 cp. delta_min_obs uses the upper (conservative) rel bounds; the point-rel value is reported alongside.

judgment.boundary_wording: No claim about conditional-shift reproducibility, transferability, mechanism or algorithm is made. Per PROTOCOL_Q section 6 and the R193 BRIEF, B/C are not started and the frozen additive/static-prior interpretation stands.
judgment.interpretation: Design check failed at: mde80_obs_le_delta_min_obs. The matched-quadruple universe has 1501 cell pairs from only 96 cells; within-screen barcode split-half reliability is 0.864 (Original, 61 cp) / 0.741 (Validation, 1501 cp) but the cell-cluster-robust null SE (n_eff=189.2) implies MDE80_obs=0.2042 > delta_min_obs=0.0893. The design therefore cannot resolve a latent rho=0.10 conditional shift with 80% power; this is a design/power stop, NOT evidence that the conditional shift is absent or unstable.
judgment.main_q_note: PROTOCOL_Q section 7: design check not passed -> STOP, do not enter the Q retest; no cross-screen Q statistic was computed or written
judgment.power_semantics_note: Complete-rule power is required only at latent rho=0.30; the reproducible threshold lives at latent ~0.10, so a true latent effect between 0.10 and 0.30 cannot be reliably classified by this design (power(0.10)=0.174 vs power(0.30)=0.896 here). A not_reproducible outcome in this design would therefore NOT license reading the 0.10-0.30 interval as "no structure".
judgment.reliability_uncertainty_note: delta_min_obs is computed with the CONSERVATIVE (upper 95%) reliability bounds (relA_hi=0.984, relB_hi=0.810 -> delta_min_obs=0.0893); with point reliabilities it would be 0.0800. Original barcode-split reliability rests on only 61 cell pairs, so its CI is wide (rel CI shown in design_check.reliability). Both values stay below MDE80_obs, so the design-check verdict is unchanged under either bound.
unfreeze_conditions: more independent cells / more independent measurement groups (the effective sample size is cell-limited: n_eff ~ 189.2 from 96 cells), or
a pre-registered delta_min_latent with an operational justification below 0.10 (the current protocol forbids back-computing it from old CI bounds), or
an analysis unit with larger effective independent sample (e.g., more screening studies matched across batches) - not a different aggregation of the same 96 cells

pre_registered_implementation_notes: design check precedes any cross-screen Q statistic; within-screen split-half reliability and structure-only SE constructions are the only response-value uses in the design phase
the design-phase q1.py asserts that if design_check fails, no cross-screen Q / main statistic is computed or written (protocol section 7)

MDE80_obs primary construction is the cluster-adjusted null SE derived from within-screen barcode split-half reliability (n_eff = ((1-r^2)/SE_boot)^2); iid analytic, debiased and zero-model cell-share constructions are reported as sensitivities only
delta_min_obs uses the conservative (upper) reliability bounds (Lead implementation note 2)
coverage/rel gate: per screen keys_with_ge2_barcodes>=300, split cp>=50, rel CI lower bound>=0.20
